title: OEBF IFC Mapping
description: How a bundle's entities are written to IFC. Optional: without ifc/mapping.json the exporter uses each entity's own ifc_type, the material names, and one property set called OEBF_Properties.

classes.description: IFC class to write for an entity's ifc_type, for example IfcWall to IfcWallStandardCase. An ifc_type not listed is written as it is.

property_sets.description: Where an element or slab property goes in IFC, keyed by the OEBF property name. A property not listed goes into OEBF_Properties.

pset.description: IFC property set, for example Pset_WallCommon

name.description: Property name inside that set, for example FireRating

materials.description: IFC material name for a material id. A material not listed uses its name from the library.
